name: Exec Cluster E04: Fixed Dollar Risk + R:R Take Profit
description: Tests: risk_unit with risk_mode=fixed and rr_ratio for bundled TP
source:
# =============================================================================
# EXEC CLUSTER E04: Fixed Dollar Risk + Bundled R:R Take Profit
# Tests: risk_mode="fixed", rr_ratio=2.0, stop_unit="percent"
# =============================================================================

src = study_assets()
close = src.c

# === VOLATILITY ===
atr_val = atr(src.h, src.l, src.c, 14)

# === SIGNAL: RSI mean reversion ===
rsi_val = rsi(close, 14)
entry_long = rsi_val < 30
exit_long = rsi_val > 70
held = hold_until(entry_long, exit_long)

# === EXECUTION ===
long_and_short_zone()(long_entry=held)

# E04: Fixed $500 risk per trade, percent-based stop, 2:1 R:R bundled TP
risk_unit(
    risk_mode="fixed",
    stop_unit=StopUnit.percent,
    rr_ratio=2.0,
    min_size=1,
    lot_size=1
)(risk_pct=500, stop_distance=3)
